label: databricks: bundle validate
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle validate

label: databricks: bundle plan
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle plan

label: databricks: bundle deploy
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle deploy

label: databricks: bundle run (pick resource)
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle run

label: databricks: bundle run "$ZED_SELECTED_TEXT"
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle run "$ZED_SELECTED_TEXT"

label: databricks: bundle summary
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle summary

label: databricks: bundle destroy (confirmation required)
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks bundle destroy

label: databricks: refresh bundle schema
command: mkdir -p .zed && databricks bundle schema > .zed/databricks-bundle.schema.json.tmp && mv .zed/databricks-bundle.schema.json.tmp .zed/databricks-bundle.schema.json && databricks --version > .zed/databricks-bundle.schema.version && echo "Bundle schema written for $(cat .zed/databricks-bundle.schema.version). Run 'editor: restart language server' in a YAML buffer to reload it."

label: databricks: auth describe
command: echo "▶ bundle target: ${DATABRICKS_BUNDLE_TARGET:-<bundle default>} | profile: ${DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE:-<DEFAULT>}" && databricks auth describe
